thread:
Drew (Support): Hotseat alert: MosaicAI onboarding experiencing a provisioning surge where ~18% of first-time SAML exchanges return 403 (aud mismatch). Customer in onboarding cohort; renewal in ~4.5 weeks. Raised INC-9120. Need CS to take customer comms + short enablement while SE triages.

Nina (CS): Thanks Drew. Can you confirm whether failing users share the same IdP or region? Also whos the Mosaic POC?

Drew (Support): Failures seen across Okta and Azure, across regions. POC is Hana (hana@mosaic.ai). Minimal repro: 
```
1) Upload SAML metadata to tenant
2) Trigger POST /v1/tenant/provision with embed scope
3) Token exchange -> 403 "audience_not_valid"
```
Logs: "auth: aud mismatch expected 'redwood-svc' got 'redwood-embed'". I pushed logs + traces to INC-9120.

Carlos (CSM): Marking P0 for CS due to onboarding impact + upcoming renewal. Proposed comms plan: short transparent note to Hana, offer immediate manual provisioning for priority users, schedule a 25m enablement slot, and place a renewal watch in CRM. Ill draft the note.

Zoe (Solutions Eng): I can own triage. Hypothesis: audience header normalization regressed in last deploy. Short mitigation: accept both aud values behind a feature flag and log originals. Plan: run aud-mapping across traces, enable permissive toggle in staging, smoke test, then canary to prod. ETA for RCA ~2.5h; staging canary ~1.5h.

Nina (CS): Owners: Zoe = SE owner, Carlos = CS owner, Drew = Support owner. Nina will coordinate renewal watch & postmortem. Carlos please include manual-provision play link and offer two walkthrough slots.

Carlos (CSM): Draft to Hana: "Hi Hana — were investigating an intermittent provisioning issue affecting a subset of users during onboarding. We can provision impacted users manually and run a 25-minute walkthrough to unblock you while engineering works on a fix. Initial update in ~2.5 hours; targeted resolution within 24 hours. Please reply with priority user emails for immediate provisioning." Posting when sent.

Drew (Support): DM'ed impacted user list + sample session_ids to Carlos. Incident updated.

InfraBot: INC-9120 | Priority: P1 -> P0 (escalated) | Owners: Zoe (SE), Carlos (CSM) | Status: triage in progress | https://redwood.incidents/INC-9120

Zoe (Solutions Eng): Quick tactical note: Ill run an aud-enumeration job to see variance. If only two aud variants, Ill enable permissive acceptance with an audit header, push a staging canary, and include a rollback flag. If we see more variants, escalate to infra for token issuance investigation. Will ping with canary link.

Carlos (CSM): Sent email to Hana (link posted). Included manual provisioning playbook: https://redwood.playbooks/manual-provisioning and offered 09:30 or 14:00 PT walkthrough. Hana replied asking for two immediate provisions; starting manual ops now.

Nina (CS): Filing renewal watch note: "Onboarding friction; SE triage in flight; manual provisioning done for priority users; renewal in ~4.5w." Reconnect after Zoe's staging canary update. Thanks everyone. :pray:
